description: This header file defines internal function prototypes for the Sys Rro Sint object in the BroadWay Runtime System environment. The functions primarily handle data record retrieval and setting, including value operations.

methods.name: SysRroSintGetRecordData
methods.description: Retrieves the data record from the Sys Rro Sint object into a buffer.

methods.name: SysRroSintSetRecordData
methods.description: Sets the data record of the Sys Rro Sint object from a buffer.

methods.name: SysRroSintGetRecordValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the data record as a long integer.

methods.name: SysRroSintSetRecordValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the data record using a long integer.
